note: Sites known to hold cuneiform tablets that are not (yet) in any ingested corpus. Curated by hand; not in the live DB.

sites.modern_name: Kunara, on the Tanjaro River, ~10 km SW of Sulaymaniyah
sites.coord_source: Wikipedia 'Tell Kunara' (35°31′10″N 45°21′34″E); consistent with Tenu 2020 ('about 10 km south-west of Sulaymaniyah, on the bank of the Tanjaro River'). No Pleiades place found.
sites.est_note: ~146 Akkadian administrative tablets and fragments, c. 2200–2100 BCE; more found in 2026
sites.period: Late 3rd millennium BCE (Old Akkadian / Ur III)

sources.citation: A. Tenu, 'The 2016-2017 Excavation Seasons in Kunara (Iraqi Kurdistan)', Proc. 11th ICAANE vol. 2 (2020) 435-444
A. Tenu, B. Chiti, Ph. Clancier, F. Marchand, J. Monerie, 'Kunara. Rapport préliminaire sur la sixième campagne de fouilles (2018)', Akkadica 141/1 (2020) 25-69
